tutorial.title: How to Play
tutorial.merge_body: Match two units of the same type and tier to create one stronger piece. Merging saves board space and is your main route to carrying late waves.
tutorial.grid_body: Only the 3×3 battle grid fights. Put knights in front to buy time, then let rogues and archers attack through the lane they create.
tutorial.bench_body: The bench is your staging area. Keep spare pairs there, line up future merges, and avoid clogging your active board before a wave starts.
tutorial.summon_body: Summons feed your merge engine. Spend gold when it helps you hit an upgrade or stabilize the next fight, not just because the button is available.
tutorial.research_body: Each cleared wave advances your active run research. Pick the tab that matches your current plan: army power, castle survival, enemy control, or economy tempo.
tutorial.permanent_body: Meta currency unlocks long-term upgrades between runs. Use it to smooth weak openings, expand options, and build toward stronger starts.
tutorial.start_wave_body: Winning pays gold and advances research. Leaks hit the castle, so every placement decision is really a survival check for the next wave.
tutorial.footer: Build for the next wave, merge for the wave after that.

1.story: Frontline anchor that absorbs pressure and holds space for the rest of the army. Tier 1 knights are siege-line veterans trained to stand where the army would otherwise break.
mechanics: Knights hold the frontline and convert tier 1 durability into extra time for every backliner behind them.
Best used as the first point of contact so archers keep firing and rogues get clean follow-up windows.

1.story: Aggressive melee finisher built to punish openings and snowball merges into kills. Tier 1 rogues fight like executioners, slipping into weak points before the enemy line can recover.
mechanics: Rogues thrive on short melee trades and hit harder each time you merge into a cleaner, denser carry.
Keep them just behind a knight or on a protected lane so they spend more time attacking than walking.

1.story: Backline specialist that delivers safe ranged damage while the frontline buys time. Tier 1 archers win battles by patience, cutting down threats long before they can answer in kind.
mechanics: Archers convert distance into safety, letting tier 1 range pressure keep firing while tougher units stall for them.
Place them behind the frontline and let research or merges turn steady chip damage into wave control.
